title: MEASURING HOW LLMS INTERNALIZE HUMAN PSYCHOLOGICAL CONCEPTS: A PRELIMINARY ANALYSIS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the alignment between LLM semantic representations and human psychological constructs by calculating pairwise similarity scores of items from 43 standardized psychological questionnaires and comparing the resulting hierarchical clusters to expert-labeled categories.
Comparing the classification accuracy of language models when psychological questionnaire items are presented in normal versus reverse order to test for premise order effects.
